Maria G: folks, onboarding question — for the new on‑prem telemetry collector (customer sidecar) what minimal egress do we need to document for VPC firewalls?
Dan P: need outbound to our ingest bridge, TLS only, port 443. IPs ideally by FQDN with fallback to CIDR list.
Sophie S: +1 TLS. we also need mTLS option for high‑security customers (certs pinned) and KMS signing for audit hooks.
Kyle I: for startup customers who can't do mTLS, we support client cert auth via enroll workflow. the agent will call /enroll to rotate certs.
Maria G: can we give a tiny config snippet for the docs? customers keep asking for exact ip/host and DNS TTL guidance.
Lee (SE): here's what works in practice — allow outbound to telemetry.ingest.redwoodapi.com:443, and if you must use IPs, allow 3 CIDRs we've published (will add link). also allow egress to audit.redwoodapi.com:443 for audit webhook deliveries.
Dan P: sample firewall entries we give ops teams (short):
```
# allow agent to telemetry endpoint
ALLOW OUT tcp any telemetry.ingest.redwoodapi.com 443
# optional audit webhook
ALLOW OUT tcp any audit.redwoodapi.com 443
```
Sophie S: note on KMS: customers with Private plan can optionally configure their KMS ARNs for envelope encryption. we validate key policy requires: kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey. Example alias: arn:aws:kms:us‑west‑2:123456789012:key/abcd‑ef01‑2345 or alias/ri/onprem‑export.
Kyle I: and the agent will attach a signed JWT for audit events. audit-bot will verify aud claim. for firewall folks: allow outbound to sts and kms endpoints if they're using IAM roles.
Maria G: thanks. question: are we still doing push vs pull for metrics export? some customers prefer inbound pull into their SIEM.
Lee (SE): we support both. default is push (agent -> ingest). for pull we expose a secured SFTP endpoint in the private deployment (customer pulls aggregated bundles hourly). note: pull requires inbound rules.
Sophie S: security reqs for push: TLS1.2+, cipher list we mandate, and ocsp stapling. we also record TLS fingerprint in audit logs.
Dan P: ops note — our ingest bridge will accept up to 10k min reqs per customer. recommend batching on the agent with max_batch_size=500 and flush_interval=2s. snippet: 
```
agent:
  batch:
    max_size: 500
    flush_ms: 2000
  tls:
    verify_server: true
    ciphers: "EECDH+AESGCM:EDH+AESGCM:AES256+EECDH"
```
Maria G: perfect. can someone from eng‑infra double‑check the firewall doc before I add to onboarding?
Kyle I: i'm on it, i'll add precise CIDRs + cloudfront vs alb notes. will ping once updated.
Lee (SE): i'll draft a short checklist for SEs: enroll flow, KMS mapping, allowlist, fallback IP list, audit webhook test steps.
Sophie S: security will add the KMS policy snippet and a template key policy for customers to copy.
Dan P: deploy-bot: create docs PR when Kyle and Sophie signal ready? :deploy:
deploy-bot: created PR #4823 for onboarding/collector/firewall — awaiting reviews.
audit-bot: audit event created: onprem.telemetry.onboard.request by Maria G at 1968765432
Maria G: awesome. thanks everyone. i'll wait for the PR then update the public KB and the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
